bibliographic.title: Benchmarking large language models for congenital cataract parent counseling: safety, readability, and knowledge translation of developmental and genetic information
bibliographic.authors: Ligang Jiang, Yihan Zhu, Chunyan Song, Xinya Hu, Xianming Fan, Weihua Yang, Yune Zhao
bibliographic.venue: Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology
bibliographic.citation_apa: Jiang, L., Zhu, Y., Song, C., Hu, X., Fan, X., Yang, W., & Zhao, Y. (2026). Benchmarking large language models for congenital cataract parent counseling: safety, readability, and knowledge translation of developmental and genetic information. Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology, 14, 1785731. https://doi.org/10.3389/fcell.2026.1785731

methodology.study_design: Cross-sectional comparative evaluation of five publicly accessible Chinese conversational LLMs using 30 standardized parent-facing questions, with blinded expert ratings and statistical group comparisons
methodology.sample_description: Five Chinese conversational LLMs (ChatGPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Pro, DeepSeek-V3.1, Doubao, Kimi K2); 30 standardized congenital cataract parent-facing questions developed by senior ophthalmologists across five domains; two researchers independently queried models; two blinded ophthalmologists rated responses
methodology.sample_size: 30 questions x 5 LLMs; 2 querying investigators; 2 rating ophthalmologists
methodology.technology_context: Publicly accessible Chinese conversational LLMs evaluated via zero-shot parent counseling queries in pediatric ophthalmology (congenital cataract), without customized system prompts, using independent conversation sessions per question

eligibility.decision_rationale: The study provides empirical comparative evidence on safety, readability, and counseling quality of conversational LLMs in a regulated healthcare setting, with blinded expert oversight and standardized querying. However, the provided text focuses on clinical content benchmarking rather than conversational governance mechanisms such as guardrails, auditability, compliance frameworks, accountability structures, or post-deployment operational governance.
eligibility.manual_spotcheck_reason: Only front matter and partial methods/findings excerpts are available; full limitations, ethics, and governance-related discussion sections were not supplied and should be verified before final coding.

appraisal.notes: Methods are clearly described for zero-shot benchmarking, independent sessions, dual investigators, blinded ratings, and statistical testing with inter-rater reliability. Ethics approval, limitations, and reflexivity are not evidenced in the supplied excerpts.

cerqual.explanation: The benchmarking design is coherent and adequately reported in the available text, with statistically supported between-model differences on safety and accessibility. Confidence is moderate rather than high because supplied evidence is incomplete, the study addresses clinical safety benchmarking rather than governance architecture, and transferability is limited to Chinese-language pediatric ophthalmology counseling.

coding.theme: Safety and quality benchmarking of conversational LLMs for medical parent counseling
coding.subtheme: Pediatric ophthalmology congenital cataract counseling in Chinese

synthesis.main_claim: LLM performance in translating lens developmental pathology and genetics for congenital cataract parent counseling is model-dependent; longer outputs did not necessarily mean higher quality, and structured presentation was more closely associated with better safety and accessibility.
synthesis.contribution: Provides quantitative benchmarks intended to support safer, parent-centered deployment of LLMs in pediatric ophthalmology education and more reliable translation of complex disease-related knowledge into actionable parent guidance.
synthesis.use_in_review: Use as supporting evidence on safety/readability benchmarking and expert-rated evaluation of conversational LLMs in a regulated healthcare counseling context; not primary evidence for conversational governance frameworks, auditability, compliance controls, or operational oversight mechanisms.
